digest.component_or_area: mutation differ and reconciliation call site
propositions: The raw compute_mutations API must treat its first argument as real local state and emit field_drift for state mismatches, serving as a load-bearing positive control for API-contract-honoring callers.

The production snapshot call site passes both remote Jira state (prev_snapshot and curr_snapshot), violating the raw API contract; A4-1 filters differ-owned emissions at that boundary to preserve the positive control.

Changing _compute_mutations_emit_both directly would break the raw-differ positive control and contradict the intentional A4-1 design that keeps suppression at the call site for future local-state migrations.
The call-site filter successfully suppresses field_drift and unbound_local emissions in production while genuine inbound creates and invariant repairs pass through unchanged.
